gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Applying a ZoneOffset as a TemporalAdjuster to a JulianDate should throw UnsupportedTemporalTypeException because OffsetSeconds is not a supported field.
ADDED i5: range(YEAR) should return a non-null ValueRange representing the proleptic year bounds.
ADDED i6: range(YEAR_OF_ERA) should return a non-null ValueRange for year-of-era bounds.
ADDED i7: range(PROLEPTIC_MONTH) should return a non-null ValueRange for proleptic month bounds.
ADDED i8: prolepticYear with AD era should return the year-of-era value unchanged (AD 652 -> proleptic 652).
ADDED i9: prolepticYear with BC era should return 1 - yearOfEra (BC 19 -> proleptic -18).
ADDED i10: isLeapYear should return true for -11999988, which is divisible by 4.
ADDED i11: dateEpochDay(2) should create a JulianDate in the AD era (epoch day 2 falls in year AD 1970).
ADDED i12: dateNow(null clock) should throw NullPointerException because the clock must not be null.
ADDED i15: eras() should return a non-empty list containing the Julian eras (BC and AD).
ADDED i16: Passing a non-Julian era (ThaiBuddhistEra) to date(Era, ...) should throw ClassCastException.
ADDED i19: Passing a non-Julian era (ThaiBuddhistEra) to dateYearDay(Era, ...) should throw ClassCastException.
ADDED i22: date(63, 63, 63) should throw DateTimeException because month 63 is outside valid range 1-12.
ADDED i25: getDisplayName should return "Julian" and getCalendarType should return "julian".
ADDED i26: dateYearDay(prolepticYear=2, dayOfYear=2) should return a date in the AD era.
ADDED i27: eraOf(-1073741823) should throw DateTimeException because the value is not a valid era index.
ADDED i30: zonedDateTime(TemporalAccessor) should convert a ZonedDateTime into a ChronoZonedDateTime.
ADDED i31: dateNow() with no arguments should return a date in the AD era (current date is in AD).
ADDED i32: resolveDate with an empty field map should return null (no date fields to resolve).
